calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

spec.hypothesis: Ball/team inputs permit provider-specific dead-ball shortcuts. Restrict P(D) to the existing strictly player-only feature block.
spec.design: Two factorized networks with identical weights/capacity/optimizer/inputs/augmentation; only the D input path differs. Both execute two shared-weight GRU passes. Original joint GRU and baseline are archived comparators.
spec.training: Unchanged joint-GRU clean/coarse and 25% whole-window ball-gap recipe; direct and H/A-swapped records; equal source/match weights; train-only normalization; eight epochs; same categorical likelihood, no D class weighting; AdamW .001/.0001, batch64, hidden24; fixed seeds2026/2027.
spec.output: P(H/A)=(1-P(D))*P(H/A|live); D sigmoid and live softmax. Fixed original Viterbi cost3. D sees only player values and their missingness masks in constrained arm.
spec.analysis: Report both seeds, mean/range (not a seed-selected checkpoint or ensemble), all providers, clean and two fixed stress views. Paired control isolates D information restriction; original joint comparison also changes output factorization.
spec.guardrail: For both seeds: +.01 equal-provider clean spell vs current recipe; no provider clean D-F1 or macro-F1 more than .02 below current recipe; stress spell no more than .01 below current recipe. Descriptive development screen only, no promotion.
spec.adaptive_exposure: Hypothesis follows the already-read five-match results. These are reused development matches; provider holdout does not undo researcher exposure. No fresh confirmation claim.
spec.anti_overfit: Exactly two arms x two seeds x three provider folds; all 12 checkpoints frozen before any new scoring; fixed training duration; no early stopping, feature/threshold/decoder sweep, best-seed selection, or follow-on tuning from these scores.
